item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that outcome. We must stop this race before anyone crosses the finish line.

2. We cannot build superintelligence first and figure out control later. With anything like current techniques, that path ends in the death of everyone on Earth. We demand prevention, not promises.

3. We stand for a future in which humanity survives. Building superintelligence with anything like current techniques destroys that future for everyone. We must stop its development—not merely slow the race.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We have a clear starting point: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We will not soften that statement to make it easier to hear. Our task is to prevent that outcome, not to make the race toward it sound responsible. We demand binding limits that stop development before superintelligence is built, backed by international cooperation and real enforcement. We reject the idea that any company or government has the right to gamble with everyone’s existence. We are organising for humanity’s survival, and we will keep that purpose at the centre of everything we do. Our future is worth defending.
